tema: Present Perfect with Ever / Never — Have You Ever...?

cast_dialogue.linea: 'Have you ever...?' is the magic question, heroes. It opens the door to every story a person carries inside.
Have you ever eaten octopus? I've never tried it — it looks scary!
I've eaten it many times in Japan! But I've never seen snow. Have you ever seen it, Sofía?
Yes, I've seen snow in the Andes. And I've ridden a horse, but I've never ridden a camel.
I've danced tango in Argentina and I've met a famous actor. Never say never, mis héroes — life surprises you!

banco_oraciones.oracion: She has ridden a camel in the desert.
We have seen snow in the mountains.
They have met a famous actor.
Have they ever won a competition?
Have you ever seen snow? Yes, I have.
Has he ever ridden a camel? No, he hasn't.
Have you ever sung in public? No, I haven't.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: 'Have you ever + past participle?' asks about life experience at any time before now. Answer with 'Yes, I have / No, I haven't' or add details with once, twice, never. 'Ever' goes in questions; 'never' makes the sentence negative.

filas: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

ejercicios.pregunta: I have ___ seen snow. I live near the beach!

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'I have never eaten octopus' means the same as 'I haven't ever eaten octopus'.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: Have you ever rode a horse?
ejercicios.respuesta: Have you ever ridden a horse?

ejercicios.instruccion: Turn it into a question with 'ever'.

ejercicios.pregunta: Answer with details: Have you ever done something scary? What was it?
ejercicios.respuesta: Yes, I have. I have ridden a roller coaster twice. It was amazing!

guion: Ben: Have you ever eaten octopus, Sofía?
Sofía: Yes, I've eaten it twice in Spain. It's delicious!
Ben: Wow. I've never tried it. Have you ever seen snow, Kenji?
Kenji: No, I've never seen snow. But I've visited a volcano!
Sofía: Amazing! And Abuela Carmen has danced tango in Argentina.
Ben: Really? She has had the most interesting life!
Kenji: Yes. Her stories are always the best.

comprension.pregunta: How many times has Sofía eaten octopus?

reading.texto: Have you ever eaten octopus? Ben has never tried it, but Sofía has eaten it twice in Spain. Kenji has travelled to many countries, yet he has never seen snow. Abuela Carmen has had the most interesting life: she has danced tango in Argentina, she has ridden a camel, and she has even met a famous actor. The friends have shared many stories, but hers are always the best.

preguntas.afirmacion: Abuela Carmen has ridden a camel.
